title: Frequency Response Estimator
text: Estimate plant frequency responses during simulation or in real time, 5 inputs, 4 outputs, {Experiment mode} sets Experiment mode; {Sample time (Ts)} sets the experiment sample time, {Output Signal Configuration} sets the provide control signal plus perturbation or perturbation only control action +, {Data Type} sets the floating point precision, {Excitation signal source}, {Frequencies}, {Frequency units}, {Amplitudes}, {Number of frequencies in the excitation signal} sets the number of externally supplied frequencies, {Number of settling periods} sets the number of periods to wait for settling, {Number of estimation periods} sets the number of periods after settling to use, {Number of periods of the lowest frequency used for estimation} sets the duration of data-collection window, {Number of periods}, {Signal order} sets the pRBS signal order, {Use Auto-Generated Value} sets the pRBS signal parameters automatically, {Estimation mode} sets the whether block performs estimation or only collects response data, {Display Bode plot} plots estimated frequency response, {Baseline plant model} sets the baseline model for Bode plot and {Refresh plot every N*Ts seconds where N is} sets how often to update Bode plot. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: start/stop
ports.summary: Start and stop the estimation experiment scalar

params.name: Output Signal Configuration
params.values: Provide control signal plus perturbation or perturbation only control action + perturbation (default) | perturbation only

params.name: Excitation signal source
params.values: Excitation signal source Block parameters (default) | External ports

params.name: Amplitudes
params.values: Amplitudes of injected perturbations 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Number of frequencies in the excitation signal
params.values: Number of externally supplied frequencies 3 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Experiment mode
params.values: Experiment mode Sinestream (default) | Superposition | PRBS (since R2023a)

params.name: Number of settling periods
params.values: Number of periods to wait for settling of transients 2 (default) | positive integer | vector of positive integers

params.name: Number of estimation periods
params.values: Number of periods after settling to use for estimation 4 (default) | integer ≥ 2 | vector of integers

params.name: Number of periods of the lowest frequency used for estimation
params.values: Duration of data-collection window 3 (default) | integer between 1 and 5

params.name: Number of periods
params.values: Number of periods in PRBS signal 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Use Auto-Generated Value
params.values: Set PRBS signal parameters automatically off (default) | on

params.name: Estimation mode
params.values: Whether block performs estimation or only collects response data Online (default) | Offline

params.name: Display Bode plot
params.values: Plot estimated frequency response off (default) | on

params.name: Baseline plant model
params.values: Baseline model for Bode plot [] (default) | LTI model

params.name: Refresh plot every N*Ts seconds where N is
params.values: How often to update Bode plot 100 (default) | scalar
